card.name: Linking words before serious harm terms
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as 'including', 'and' or 'of' that come right before a named serious harm, such as arrhythmia, flooding, hemorrhage or severe skin reactions. Also adjectives like 'disastrous' before floods.

modes.label: Link before adverse event
modes.description: 'including' or 'and' after a warning term, ahead of a named serious reaction.
modes.example: can cause severe diarrhea,<< including>> life threatening and fatal cases.

modes.label: Hazard or disaster wording
modes.description: A word leading into floods or recurrent flooding in geography text.
modes.example: is flanked by low banks, and<< disastrous>> floods sometimes inundate large areas.

modes.label: Grade numbers
modes.description: A grade digit before a heart or organ event in trial results.

card.writes: No clear link to the promoted and suppressed tokens; they look unrelated and mixed.
card.plain: It fires on the small word just before a serious harm is named, like 'including' before torsades or hemorrhage.
